doc: Zoom blur: average of the premultiplied rgba along the straight line from each pixel towards (centerX, centerY) (fractions of the document); the streak covers amount % of the pixel's distance to the centre (amount 100 = all the way to the centre). Taps: ceil(streak length in px), capped at 64, starting at the pixel itself, equally weighted, bilinear; outside the document is transparent. Quality: smooth while the streak is <= 64 px; longer streaks (far from the centre, large amount) have tap spacing > 1 px and may show faint stepping on fine detail. Extent = document.

amount.doc: streak length as % of the distance to the centre
